title: Design secure network architectures and segmentation: concept decisions 3
teachingQuestion: Which boundary, protocol endpoint, and management path constrain a risky flow without creating an unseen bypass?
focalInsight: Security comes from matched physical, logical, workload, identity, and observable enforcement—not from a topology label or encryption alone.
caption: Read across a row to connect meaning, decision and consequence. Use the retrieval answer to check your explanation after reading the linked scenario.

nodes.label: Network Segmentation
nodes.definition: Physical or logical restriction of communication between network groups to reduce reachability and blast radius.
nodes.detail: Physical or logical restriction of communication between network groups to reduce reachability and blast radius.
nodes.decision: Define zones and enforce/observe every required crossing using policy that matches the actual flow.
nodes.failureExample: A separate VLAN has an unrestricted routed path into a sensitive subnet.
nodes.retrievalAnswer: Segmentation works at policy-enforced crossings, not as a diagram label.
